translations.idiomatic: When Zhongxian was executed, he in turn lavishly praised Gao Hongtu for saving Lian and even recommended Han Kuang and Ni Yuanlu, seeking acceptance among the upright.

sentences.zh: 帝定逆案，繼春不列名，帝問故。

translations.literal: When the emperor settled the treason cases, Jichun's name was not listed; the emperor asked why.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor settled the treason cases, Jichun's name was not listed; the emperor asked why.

sentences.zh: 閣臣言繼春雖反覆，持論亦可取。

translations.literal: The Grand Secretaries said that though Jichun was fickle, his arguments could still be valued.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Secretaries said that though Jichun was fickle, his arguments could still be valued.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「惟反覆，故為真小人。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "It is precisely because he is fickle that he is a true petty man."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "It is precisely because he is fickle that he is a true petty man."

sentences.zh: 遂引交結近侍律，坐徒三年，自恨死。

translations.literal: He then invoked the statute on consorting with close attendants, sentenced him to three years' penal servitude, and Jichun died of remorse.
translations.idiomatic: He then invoked the statute on consorting with close attendants, sentenced him to three years' penal servitude, and Jichun died of remorse.

sentences.zh: 田爾耕

translations.literal: Tian Ergeng
translations.idiomatic: Tian Ergeng

sentences.zh: 許顯純

translations.literal: Xu Xianchun
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xianchun

sentences.zh: 顯純，定興人，駙馬都尉從誠孫也。

translations.literal: Xianchun was a native of Dingxing, grandson of the Commandant-in-Chief of the Horse Guard Congcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xianchun was a native of Dingxing, grandson of the Commandant-in-Chief of the Horse Guard Congcheng.

sentences.zh: 舉武會試，擢錦衣衛都指揮僉事。

translations.literal: He passed the military metropolitan examination and was promoted to Vice Commander of the Brocade Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military metropolitan examination and was promoted to Vice Commander of the Brocade Guard.

sentences.zh: 天啟四年，劉僑掌鎮撫司，治汪文言獄，失忠賢指，得罪，以顯純代之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianqi, Liu Qiao headed the Surveillance Bureau and handled the Wang Wenyan case; he missed Zhongxian's intent and fell from favor, and Xianchun replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tianqi, Liu Qiao headed the Surveillance Bureau and handled the Wang Wenyan case; he missed Zhongxian's intent and fell from favor, and Xianchun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 顯純略曉文墨，性殘酷，大獄頻興，毒刑鍛練，楊漣、左光鬥、周順昌、黃尊素、王之寀、夏之令等十餘人，皆死其手。

translations.literal: Xianchun had some slight learning, but a cruel nature; great cases arose one after another, and under torture and forced confession Yang Lian, Zuo Guangdou, Zhou Shunchang, Huang Zunsu, Wang Zhicai, Xia Zhiling, and more than ten others all died by his hand.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun had some slight learning but a cruel nature; great cases arose one after another, and under torture and forced confession Yang Lian, Zuo Guangdou, Zhou Shunchang, Huang Zunsu, Wang Zhicai, Xia Zhiling, and more than ten others all died by his hand.

sentences.zh: 諸人供狀，皆顯純自為之。

translations.literal: The confessions of all these men were written by Xianchun himself.
translations.idiomatic: The confessions of all these men were written by Xianchun himself.

sentences.zh: 每讞鞫，忠賢必遣人坐其後，謂之聽記，其人偶不至，即袖手不敢問。

translations.literal: At every trial Zhongxian would send a man to sit behind him, called a listening scribe; if that man happened not to come, Xianchun would fold his arms and dare not question.
translations.idiomatic: At every trial Zhongxian would send a man to sit behind him, called a listening scribe; if that man happened not to come, Xianchun would fold his arms and dare not question.

sentences.zh: 崔應元 孫雲鶴 楊寰

translations.literal: Cui Yingyuan, Sun Yunhe, Yang Huan
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yingyuan, Sun Yunhe, Yang Huan

sentences.zh: 應元，大興人。

translations.literal: Yingyuan was a native of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yingyuan was a native of Daxing.

sentences.zh: 市井無賴，充校尉，冒緝捕功，積官至錦衣指揮。

translations.literal: A market ruffian, he served as a guard, falsely claimed merit in arrests, and rose by degrees to Brocade Guard commander.
translations.idiomatic: A market ruffian, he served as a guard, falsely claimed merit in arrests, and rose by degrees to Brocade Guard commander.

sentences.zh: 雲鶴，霸州人，為東廠理刑官。

translations.literal: Yunhe was a native of Bazhou and served as judicial officer of the Eastern Depot.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yunhe was a native of Bazhou and served as judicial officer of the Eastern Depot.

sentences.zh: 寰，吳縣人。

translations.literal: Huan was a native of Wu County.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Huan was a native of Wu County.

sentences.zh: 隸籍錦衣，為東司理刑。

translations.literal: Registered with the Brocade Guard, he served as judicial officer of the Eastern Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Registered with the Brocade Guard, he served as judicial officer of the Eastern Bureau.

sentences.zh: 凡顯純殺人事，皆應元等共為之。

translations.literal: Every killing Xianchun carried out was done together with Yingyuan and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Every killing Xianchun carried out was done together with Yingyuan and the rest.

sentences.zh: 而寰為田爾耕心腹。

translations.literal: Huan was Tian Ergeng's trusted man.
translations.idiomatic: Huan was Tian Ergeng's trusted man.

sentences.zh: 及顯純論死，法司止當應元、雲鶴、寰戍。

translations.literal: When Xianchun was sentenced to death, the judicial offices judged only Yingyuan, Yunhe, and Huan fit for exile.
translations.idiomatic: When Xianchun was sentenced to death, the judicial offices judged only Yingyuan, Yunhe, and Huan fit for exile.

sentences.zh: 後定逆案，三人並論死，寰先死戍所。

translations.literal: Later, when the treason cases were settled, all three were sentenced to death; Huan died first in exile.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the treason cases were settled, all three were sentenced to death; Huan died first in exile.
